decisions.decision: The committee agreed that it needs a comprehensive look at General Municipal Land and a process to decide what to retain and what to convey, and deferred action on the other abutter requests until that process exists.
decisions.quote: the general consensus of the committee was that we need to take a comprehensive look at land

decisions.decision: Bob Pease will reach out to the Town Manager and Town Counsel about an agreement for 250 Howard Street.
decisions.quote: bob pease will reach out to the town manager and town counsel.

decisions.decision: Lynne Man will reach out to a possible volunteer for the Economic Development Committee; Karin Menard may participate if no other volunteer is found.
decisions.quote: lynne man indicated she may have someone who would be interested in serving, she will reach out to them.

decisions.decision: Paula Bertram will visit the various undesignated parcels, which other members agreed to.
decisions.quote: paula bertram commented that she would l ike to visit the various parcels, other members agreed .

decisions.decision: At the October meeting the committee will review the list of undesignated municipal land and then extend an invitation to other Boards to discuss.
